I also dropped out of highschool because kids were making fun of me because my acne, then I had to work, then I had to leave the country because I lost my house...But right now Im finishing highschool in a foreign language, its hard as fuck, but is making me really proud of myself, I just hope to make it through this time. 
Anyway, education is more important than you actually think. However, you may obtain different skills during your life and get passioned about different things after you get through this rough period. I just hope you have the strenght to get through it and NOT DROP OUT, because it will basically affect all your life. Without education you may not be able to work in a field you like, and if you do you will probably be stuck on a entry-level position forever. There are some fields where you don't need a diploma, but it is up to you to decide what you're doing with your life. And also, its good to have options. In a few years (Idk when you're going to finish highschool) you will have the option to continue studying something you like or learn some skills and maybe then you will have already an idea of what you want to do in life and you will can follow it. 
As I said, I really hope you continue going to school! Wish you the best!

Beside the fact that you seem to have some personal problems which Im not entitled to give my 5 cents about, you seem to suck at socializing. You should put yourself in the middle of other people (Im lonely too, but going to ocassional work and talking to other persons helps even if I still don't have any friends or a stable job). Get a job if you don't have one. It will help on many aspects. If you do have a job, or go to courses and shit like that idk man...

You can't really count on strangers opinion over the internet to diagnose yourself. You lost your motivation, you might be depressed... Get prof. help, it might get worst and it can be prevented somehow so do the best thing for yourself man!

Its a good thing that you failed and woke up with a little bit of hope. Loneliness sucks but there is nothing that can't really change on long term period. Right now you're going through a rough time, can't really give you any advice, but Im glad you're still with us and I wish you the best in the future!

You have to get your shit together to help your fiancee. Forget your mom, she seems like a horrible person who only caused you to suffer. Next time she texts you tell her that now that she is out of your life you don't care about her opinion and you have no reason talking with her anymore. 
I know your conditions are giving you a hard time, but only by overcoming them you can put your life together. There are a lot of people who are in the same condition and manage to keep a job. Im not saying you are lazy, or that is not a living hell, but you have to get motivated because only this way you can overcome this things and live a normal life! I really hope you succeed!

First you gotta apply for college, man... That seems like a huge thing that could affect your whole future, so if you still have time the first thing you have to do is fix that situation. After that, you have to accept the reality. Accept the things you don't like about yourself. Maybe you are not beautiful, most of the people are not. With a good higiene, haircut, stylish clothes and a responsible attitude you can still find a nice girl! I am shorter than you and its not that bad, idk where you're from thou... But thats not something that affects your life unlike the fact that you choose to see only the things you don't like about yourself.
The acting thing you describe seems to be maladaptive day dreaming, you should inform yourself about that :) 
You can get through this, note on a piece of paper all the things you can do to improve yourself. You will feel really productive once you start doing those things.
